title: The classification of integral endotrivial complexes
summary: We describe the group of endotrivial complexes, i.e., the Picard group, of the derived category of permutation modules for a finite group over a commutative Noetherian ring. As a result, we deduce that not every endotrivial with integer coefficients arises from a homotopy representation, i.e., an invertible genuine equivariant spectrum.
